classRequests.title: Class requests
classRequests.intro: Ask your coach for a class at a time they are free. The coach accepts, declines or proposes another time.
classRequests.coachIntro: Students ask for classes at times your calendar leaves free. Accept, decline or propose another time; a pending request holds its slot on your calendar.
classRequests.noCoaches: You are not on any coach's roster yet.
classRequests.noFreeBlocks: No free time on that day.
classRequests.notePlaceholder: What do you want to work on?

refusal.slot_taken: That time is not free any more
refusal.not_pending: The student is answering your proposal
refusal.not_countered: There is no proposal to answer
refusal.NO_CLUB: Join or create a club before accepting
refusal.slot_changed: That proposal is no longer the one on the table
refusal.off_series: A weekly request can only move to one of its weekdays

academy.title: Join an academy class
academy.intro: This coach's classes in the next 14 days that you can join.
academy.empty: There are no classes of this coach you can join in the next 14 days.
academy.notePlaceholder: E.g. can I arrive 10 minutes late?
academy.onWaitlist: You are on the waiting list
academy.nowFull: This class just filled up — you can join its waiting list.
academy.nowOpen: This class has room — you can ask to join.
academy.failed: Could not complete that. Please try again.
academy.emptyNotAdvertised: This coach isn't taking requests for academy classes.

classRequests.cardIntro: Ask your coach for a class. Your open requests are listed here until the coach answers, and you can withdraw one at any time.
